card.name: Gap before numbers in lab thresholds
card.fires_on: The space before a number in label text, mainly after a lab threshold such as "50 × 10" or ">", and before a contraindication section reference such as "( 4 )".

modes.label: Lab count thresholds
modes.description: Space after "×10" or a comparison sign, just before a platelet, neutrophil or triglyceride value.
modes.example: platelet count recovers to greater than or equal to 50 × 10<< >>9 /L . Discontinue BESP

modes.label: Section reference after contraindication
modes.description: Space inside parentheses before the cross-reference number 4 at the end of a contraindication item.

card.writes: It slightly favors the word "absolute" and its forms, as in absolute counts or absolute values.
card.plain: It fires on the blank space just before a number in a lab limit or a contraindication reference.
